name: agent-flow
description: Real-time visualization of Claude Code and Codex agent orchestration

enumDescriptions: Watch both Claude Code and Codex sessions concurrently (default)
agentVisualizer.runtime.description: Which agent runtime(s) to watch. In auto mode, runtimes you don't use are harmless no-ops (no session directory = nothing to scan).

agentVisualizer.devServerPort.description: Port for the development server. Set to 0 (default) for production mode, or 3002 for development.

agentVisualizer.eventLogPath.description: Path to JSONL event log file to watch for agent events

agentVisualizer.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the visualizer when an agent session starts

agentVisualizer.costs.enabled.description: Use the costs config (~/.agent-flow/costs.json and the project's .agent-flow/costs.json). When off, the built-in prices are used and the files are ignored.

agentVisualizer.costs.configPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path (or starting with `~/`) of the costs config file, instead of `~/.agent-flow/costs.json`. The environment variable `AGENT_FLOW_COSTS` does the same when this is empty. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot redirect it.

agentVisualizer.costs.displayCurrency.markdownDescription: ISO 4217 code to show costs in, e.g. `EUR`. Needs an exchange rate in the costs file (`currency.fx`), because rates are never fetched. Empty = take it from the costs file, else `USD`. Overridden by the costs file.

enumDescriptions: Take it from the costs file
Money for billed or priced usage, kWh for local models, tokens when nothing is priced
agentVisualizer.costs.unit.description: What the cost overlay shows. Overridden by the costs file.

enumDescriptions: Take it from the costs file
Price an unknown model with its provider's default rate
agentVisualizer.costs.unknownModelPolicy.markdownDescription: How a model with no price is handled. A global flat rate needs `pricing.unknownModel.globalRate` in the costs file. Overridden by the costs file.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:webview && pnpm run build
